decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. 366.01-00901-201-L-X02 Rev A901-201-L-002 Rev A901-201-L-003 Rev A901-201-L-X01 Rev A901-201-L-X03 Rev A901-201-L-000 Rev A901-201-L-001 Rev A201235-TMA-XX-RP-AP-2700-P00Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Within three months of the date of this permission, an Energy Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Energy Statement shall detail the energy efficiency and carbon reduction measures incorporated within the development, including any low-carbon or renewable energy technologies. The approved measures shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO"² emission reduction targets are maintained.

Within 3 months of the date of this permission, details of secure and covered cycle parking for a minimum of two bicycles shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance withthe approved details and shall thereafter be permanently retained and kept available for the parking and storage of bicycles.Reason: To ensure the provision of safe, secure and convenient cycle parking facilities in accordance with the Council's adopted standards and in the interests of promoting sustainable modes of transport.

Within 3 months of the date of this permission, waste and recycling storage facilities of a size and specification sufficient to serve the occupiers of the dwelling shall be provided on site in accordance with Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). The approved facilities shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development and kept available for the storage of refuse and recyclable materials at all times.Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.

The proposed boundary fencing hereby approved shall be retained and maintained in accordance with the approved plans for the lifetime of the development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the residential amenities and privacy of neighbouring occupiers and to ensure the Development remains in accordance with the approved plans.

The works, as recommended in the Retrospective Arboricultural Impact Assessment ref. 201235-TMA-XX-RP-AP-2700-P00 (July 2026), shall be implemented in full by a suitably experienced and qualified professional. For the avoidance of doubt, these works shall consist of the Mitigation Strategy which commences at paragraph 5.28 of said document and concludes at paragraph 5.34 (inclusive) of said document. This condition shall not be discharged until the works are complete, with satisfactory photographic evidence and information on the products used presented in a written report to be submitted to, and approved by, the Local Planning Authority.Reason: to improve the growing conditions (namely the soil environment) within the RPAs of retained and off-site trees, and to mitigate the negative impacts identified.

Within 3 months of the date of this permission, a Verification Report demonstrating that the approved SuDS measures have been fully implemented shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. This report must include: As built drawings of the sustainable drainage systems including level information (if appropriate) Photographs of the completed sustainable drainage systems Any relevant certificates from manufacturers/ suppliers of any drainage features. A confirmation statement of the above signed by the site manager or similar. Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development.

The first-floor side windows serving the en-suite bathroom accommodation and facing Nos. 15 and 26 The Glen, as shown on drawing no. 901-201-L-X03 Rev A, shall be fitted with obscure glazing to a minimum level 3 of the Pilkington Obscuration Range and shall remain fixed shut thereafter, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The obscure glazing shall be retained permanently and shall not be altered or removed without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties

Within three months of the date of this permission, details of all existing trees, shrubs and other planting to be retained on the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Within six months of the date of this permission, The approved landscaping scheme shall be implemented within the first planting season following the written approval of the landscaping details and shall thereafter be maintained. Any trees or shrubs which, within five years of planting, are removed, die, become seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of landscaping, biodiversity enhancement and visual amenity in the interests of the character and appearance of the area.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of landscaping and visual amenity.
